Provide user controls for discoverability, direct messages, replies, and notification categories. A transparent safety report can describe enforcement outcomes without publishing thresholds that would help attackers evade them. An emergency help link should be prominent, but the service should not promise perfect anonymity or guaranteed safety. It gives a product team an actionable specification for responsible pseudonymity; features intended to make harassment consequence-free are not part of the design. Before launch, conduct an accessibility and child-safety review, publish understandable community rules, and give affected users a human contact who can explain an enforcement decision.
